PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/2.2/ontology#ref>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?s ?o WHERE {
  ?s rdfs:label ?l .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?l), "perimeter"))
}
